episode_summary: Barely Informed News' Monday broadcast opened with an extended pre-show featuring Executive Producer Pepito and a surreal Hype Train freestyle about piss-sharpened machetes, before transitioning into a news block covering Spencer Pratt's failed LA mayoral bid, Trump's unhinged interview, a Catholic exorcist defrocked for declaring UFOs demonic, Ken Paxton's war on 'Big Gay Swim Day', and a psilocybin dementia study. The stream then pivoted to a trailer-review segment (The Giver 2, Saw Genesis, Resident Evil), a Disney-villain shirt reveal by artists Tony Cabana and Jamie, a heated Munch & Crum debate on reality-TV politicians that devolved into Crum's penile conditioning for the long-awaited gorilla dick-punch, and a CryptoZeu$ remote where Brandon wrestled with N64 emulation of Glover while his mother screamed through the wall. The broadcast closed with a raid on 'your old dad' and Case noting his upcoming birthday.

segments.title: Pepito Intro, Hype Train Machete Freestyle & Studio Banter
segments.notes: Pepito opens broadcast; Hype Train appears in starry liminal space and delivers extended freestyle about sharpening a toy machete with urine, joined by Case and Kendelle discussing home defense (machete, stun gun). Case shows off machete, Kendall does laundry on camera. Hype Train eventually 'dies' and Case hard-transitions to news.

segments.title: Spencer Pratt Loss, Trump Interview, Head of the Family, Exorcist UFOs, Ken Paxton, Psilocybin, Anal Diet, Pokemon Go Drones, Mullet Championship, Bart Tattoos
segments.notes: Case anchors with Jeff Ripple reading chat news. Topics: Spencer Pratt trailing in LA mayoral race (Case's wrong prediction), Trump's 'wet' Meet the Press interview, Case's teenage memory of softcore film 'Head of the Family' (mutant Eggman), Catholic exorcist Monsignor Rossetti stripped for UFO=demon claims, Texas AG Ken Paxton sues Denton over Big Gay Swim Day, psilocybin helps dementia patient, graphic anal-sex dietary advice, Pokemon Go scans feeding military drones, Denmark's National Mullet Championship, and ongoing Bart tattoo submissions for Case's arms.

segments.title: Trailer Review: The Giver 2, Saw Genesis, My Dream Is Yours, Dave the Driver, Resident Evil
segments.notes: Case and off-screen voices watch and rate vintage and new trailers: The Giver 2: Dark Hero (ROI-based marketing), Saw Genesis (WWII jaw-ripping), 1949 musical My Dream Is Yours, pixel-art game Dave the Driver DLC, and Resident Evil 9 reveal trailer. Case ranks them 3.42–4.75 stars.

segments.title: Disney Villain Shirt Reveal with Artists Tony Cabana & Jamie
segments.notes: Artists Tony Cabana and Jamie present custom Disney villain shirts (Pete, Perdita, Kongo, Minky Moose, Grogu, Donald, Oswald, Milana) featuring googly-eye details. Case models Pete shirt; Kendelle's mother receives Perdita. Shirts may become stickers/merch.

segments.title: Reality-TV Politicians, Spencer Pratt, Love Island Auditions, Dubai Honey Bag, Gorilla Dick-Punch Training
segments.notes: Senior debate analysts Munch and Crum clash over whether reality stars belong in politics. Munch defends Pratt's trailer-campaign authenticity; Crum argues for decorum. Personal attacks escalate: Crum's Dubai 'classified' social life, honey-bag stretch therapy, Munch's grey-haired JD Vance resemblance, and Crum's claim he's training his penis to withstand a 50-lb gorilla punch (callback to Crum Dick Punch wager). Munch endorses 'Gooters' for gay Hooters.

segments.title: Glover N64 Playthrough: Technical Hell, Maternal Abuse, Snake Eaters Restaurant Pitch
segments.notes: Brandon (CryptoZeu$) attempts Glover on N64 emulator; audio/video issues, controller mapping nightmares, inverted controls, and constant verbal abuse from his mother (yelling through door about nursing job, selling him for benzos, Mr. Pib bath prank). Brandon improvises 'Snake Eaters' all-male restaurant concept. He eventually reaches a puzzle area but quits after mental breakdown, ending stream early.

segments.title: Birthday Announcements, Pepito Moss, Raid to 'Your Old Dad'
segments.notes: Case reveals birthday Wednesday (turning 30 or 40), Pepito Moss celebration set for July 6. Final Bart tattoo showcase. Pepito demands raid; Case raids 'your old dad' playing Match Monday 74. Sign-off with birthday wishes for Kendelle's mom.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: Executive producer (canine). Opens broadcast, manages raid, announces Pepito Moss July 6.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Lead anchor & managing editor. Hosts news, trailer review, shirt reveal, debate moderation, and sign-off.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: Sentient locomotive correspondent. Delivers surreal piss-machete freestyle rap during pre-show.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: Lead anchor's girlfriend, in-studio contributor. Brings machete, does laundry on camera, receives birthday shirt, mother celebrated.

characters.name: Jeff Ripple
characters.notes: Studio news reader / breaking chat correspondent. Reads Catholic exorcist story, reacts to Alex Jones comparison, leaves to fix power issue.

characters.name: Munch
characters.notes: Senior debate analyst (disheveled silver hair). Defends reality-TV politicians, endorses Gooters, mocks Crum's hairline.

characters.name: Crum
characters.notes: Senior debate analyst (hollow-eyed, bald). Argues for political decorum, reveals Dubai 'classified' social life, honey-bag therapy, claims penile conditioning for gorilla dick-punch.

characters.name: Brandon (CryptoZeu$)
characters.notes: Resident gaming correspondent. Remote from bedroom; battles N64 emulation, mother's screaming, and Glover's inverted controls.

characters.name: Brandon's Mother
characters.notes: Unseen family voice. Constantly yells through door: nursing job pride, threatens to sell Brandon for benzos, Mr. Pib bath prank, demands chicken fries from 'Gooners'.

characters.name: Tony Cabana
characters.notes: Guest artist. Designed Disney villain shirts with googly eyes; credited for 'extremely small' theater appearance.

characters.name: Jamie
characters.notes: Guest artist. Collaborated on shirt designs; audience applauded.

storylines.beat: Crum claims he has been training his penis to withstand a 50-lb weight, escalating toward the long-awaited gorilla dick-punch execution. Munch mocks the regimen; chat demands the event.
Case's hard prediction of a Pratt victory fails as vote count hits 83% favoring Karen Bass; Case hedges psychic pain relief. Trump intervenes on Truth Social calling race rigged.
Case announces birthday Wednesday (June 10), unsure of age (30 or 40), may stream or take day off. Pepito Moss scheduled July 6.
Case reviews 100+ viewer-submitted Bart Simpson variants for full-arm tattoo; plans to order custom 12x12 sheet within three weeks.
Munch officially endorses 'Gooters' as the name for a gay Hooters; Crum and chat debate alternatives (Gators, Gooners, Booters, Sex Vacuum).

lore_notes.fact: Executive producer and canine; opens every broadcast with 'I'm Pepito, I'm the dog that produces the show.'
Travels with a panther companion; freestyles about sharpening a machete with the force of his urine, comparing it to a waterfall eroding a mountain.
Owns a toy machete on a string; keeps a stun gun for home defense (Kendelle also has one).
Auditioned for Love Island, Too Hot to Handle, and MILF Manor as a 'positive male influence' but was outside age range for the latter.
Claims a 'classified' social calendar in Dubai involving 'Rennerton water' (medicinal and defense-contract liquid that can kill a man and cure emphysema).
Uses a 'honey bag' for stretch therapy, which he says may add 10 years to his life.
Spent summers in Macedonia where 'the ancient world had different views' on same-sex relations, implying bipartisan sexual history.
Harbors intense one-sided rivalry with real-world UPI reporter Ben Hooper; audience favors Hooper's corny antics.
Refuses to pay for games ('hard I don't want to pay for games policy'); plays on Case's copies. Mother yells through bedroom door throughout broadcasts.
Walks through studio to her own signature theme music; mother celebrated on-air for birthday.
Pepito Moss celebration scheduled for July 6 (a Monday), recognized as official network holiday.
